from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json
import time
import urllib.parse

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - - [%s] %s" % (self.client_address[0], self.log_date_time_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

    def send_bytes(self, code, body, content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8"):
        if isinstance(body, str):
            body = body.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        qs = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        if parsed.path in ("/", "/health", "/healthz"):
            self.send_bytes(200, json.dumps({"ok": True, "app": "fugue-drain-canary"}) + "\n", "application/json")
            return
        if parsed.path == "/stream":
            seconds = int(qs.get("seconds", ["30"])[0])
            interval = float(qs.get("interval", ["1"])[0])
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.end_headers()
            for i in range(seconds):
                line = f"tick {i+1}/{seconds}\n".encode("utf-8")
                self.wfile.write(line)
                self.wfile.flush()
                time.sleep(interval)
            return
        if parsed.path == "/sleep":
            seconds = int(qs.get("seconds", ["1"])[0])
            time.sleep(seconds)
            self.send_bytes(200, f"slept {seconds}\n")
            return
        self.send_bytes(404, "not found\n")

ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8000), Handler).serve_forever()
